The Red Bull story is incredible when you think about it. 40 year old marketing manager heads to Thailand for a work trip. Drinks a weird drink that energizes him like nothing else. Gets rid of jet lag. Decides to carbonate it and bring it to the West. 1,000mg taurine. Caffeine. Inositol. Cane sugar. There was nothing like it. Proceeds to claim it gives you wings. Designs a skinny can that stood alone among fat cans. Buys football team. Pays mercenaries to do outrageous life threatening stunts as 'marketing'. Buys F1 team. Refuses to sell anything else. Never sold a single share. No IPO. Dude even hated borrowing from the banks. Mateschitz works till he dies. Son continues the legacy. Insane.
